cards.name: Mass Revelation
cards.summary: KEEP all four informational categories and observer-specific consequences; exact fixed 3D cone and paid-resolution origin revalidation are present.
reviewFindings: Action/V/S/F/base17 and the exact four ordinary provider placements remain unchanged.
The commitment-fixed origin and nonzero facing use the stated axial/circular cone; no extra Euclidean radial60 test is inserted.
Actually occupied included cells and current line of effect govern readable local footprints; learning a location is not sight.
The inclusive six-second assertion window still requires perceived and understood content and current speaker presence; it detects knowing false assertion, not objective replacement truth.
Current hostile intent, traps and magic retain their independently scoped protections; no faction, alignment or species shortcut is used.
boundaryConclusions: Forward60/lateral30 included; lateral30.1 or forward60.1 excluded.
Legal caster displacement does not retarget the fixed origin; loss of origin admissibility at resolution gives no effect and no refund.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-01-A: Conditional Wizard13 has a legitimate prepared Mass Revelation, usable components, no price additions and RP48. Pay17 to31. The fixed readable cone contains an actual unprotected pressure plate, Invisible hostile scout and active ward. Disclose their specified fields. The scout stays Invisible, but this caster now knows its location: Hidden and Invisible-only attack modifiers end for this observer; independent darkness still applies, and a sight-required target remains unavailable. The plate stays armed and the ward stays active. Allies need actual communication.

DI7-01-B: At resolution100, assertions at94 and99 are within the inclusive six-second window, provided their actual speakers remain in the cone and content was perceived/understood. The knowing false denial is identified; the sincere incorrect date is not. An assertion at93.999 is outside. Supply no key location or corrected date; an existence-protected mind adds no diagnostic record/count.

cards.name: Premonition Shield
cards.summary: KEEP two automatic occurrence uses, recipient-level first admission, separate damage roots and current-state prevention.
reviewFindings: The ward is attached, nonconcentration, willing/perceived ally including self, with an absolute60-second deadline and no recipient Reaction.
Misses, successful saves, zero damage and resolving nondamaging beneficial spells can consume uses; canceled/nonrecipient/excluded components do not.
One immediate spell occurrence per recipient groups its beams without merging roots, riders or separate later scheduled occurrences.
Actual retarget windows precede recipient commitment; positive pre-mitigation shares have their own actual recipient stage, while skip-prevention post-defense branches do not gain prevention.
The first eligible admission checkpoint is closed even when no usable ward exists. Replacement cannot inherit the old application commitment.
A previously committed same live ward resumes later components after suppression without a new use, but cannot operate during suppression or beyond its deadline.
boundaryConclusions: Suppressed at first beam: no later admission for that occurrence and no use spent.
Admitted first beam, suppressed second, restored third before expiry: first/third covered, one use spent.
Replacing an admitted ward ends its future coverage; the new ward has no coverage for the already-started recipient occurrence.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-03-A: A successful ward at0 has two uses and deadline60. A final-target sword miss at5 automatically consumes use1 before consequences. A different attack at6 hits: use2 prevents its24 eligible post-defense damage before temp HP, while an independent hit/Maiming condition follows its actual rule. After that occurrence finishes the ward ends; a third attack is unprotected. A zero-damage or resolving beneficial nondamaging spell could have consumed either use instead.

DI7-03-B: A single immediate spell cast has three separately rolled beams against the warded recipient. One occurrence use covers their eligible damage without merging the three roots. An actual later tick is another occurrence and uses the second. A separately transferred post-defense6 flagged skipPrevention receives no new ward prevention or use; a real positive pre-mitigation share instead has its own recipient defense stage and may qualify once against that parent occurrence.

cards.name: Fate Echo
cards.summary: KEEP the complete paid nested-cast procedure, original-event admission, selected source modes, fresh child outcomes and Ready lifecycle.
reviewFindings: The exact original must actually have resolved successfully, been directly perceived and identified, and meet its18-second original-casting-time window.

Admission checks a complete nondamaging rank0–7 Action/Bonus Action procedure, not merely a favorable or zero-damage outcome. Null, recursive/copy-access, unsupported and disallowed modes remain excluded.
The temporary copy grant waives only its stated ordinary repertoire/list restriction; no donor statistics, independent materials, acquired charges or engine permission are supplied.

Outer and child have separate commitments, chronological prices/strain, counter identities and concentration effects. Reservation is not payment; later child failure does not refund an already committed outer.
The child uses the actual Fate provider and current own statistics/focus, with the reviewed copy-route strain rules, not ordinary prepared-Wizard or Shaman-totem exemptions.
Ready pays the outer at preparation, requires actual held-spell concentration and spends one real release Reaction; it does not refresh the selected original or create a second outer cast.
D7T-08-02 and D7T-10-01 are sufficient for authored review within the exact source/adapter limits documented in DI7_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_ADDENDUM.json.
boundaryConclusions: A damaging procedure that missed still fails the nondamage predicate.
A countered outer spends no uncommitted child payment; an actually committed countered child keeps its own payment/history.
A complete source not implemented by this local evaluator is not thereby categorically prohibited by the authored Fate rule.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-04-A: Conditional Wizard13 INT+4/PB5 has RP48, Dissonance0, no prior same-name Refrain and Fate Echo as its first prepared-matrix family of a genuine encounter. It directly witnessed an eligible complete rank1 nondamaging original at0; commitment at18 qualifies. Outer price17 leaves31 and its actual prepared-family exemption yields0 base strain. The child is a copied route, not another matrix: base2 leaves29 and common rank1 base strain gives Dissonance1. Both have distinct cast IDs; fresh lawful targets/components and independent uses are required. If the Fate matrix exemption was already spent, the same low-strain prices leave29 but Dissonance becomes3, not1.

DI7-04-B: Reject a damaging spell that missed, a copy-descended event and a source19 seconds old. In a separate legal copy, countering the outer spends only the actually committed outer obligations and releases unused child reservations; there is no child history. If the child was committed and countered, both actual payments and both histories remain spent. A copied Reaction-only Shield mode is ineligible despite being nondamaging.

particularDependencies: Every future copied mode still requires its own actual complete source, operative adapter and independent entitlements; these seven-card findings do not implement or approve all possible payloads.

cards.name: Vision Quest
cards.summary: KEEP the paid60-second stationary conscious concentration procedure and the bounded source-supported answer.
reviewFindings: Action starts the real sixty-second procedure with a fixed related perceived local anchor; no free instant question or successful work credit occurs.
Voluntary movement, Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions and deliberate communication are unavailable during the trance as stated; voluntary termination precedes an otherwise legal Reaction.
Forced displacement/transport, incapacity, concentration loss and suppression end the procedure without partial output or refund; damage follows the actual concentration check.
Normal completion delivers the specified at-most150-word answer/up-to3 source-supported steps and at-most30-day future horizon; unavailable knowledge is not invented.
Delivered knowledge and subsequent legal communication are separate. The local communication module correction does not grant a universal instant channel.
boundaryConclusions: Interruption before normal completion gives no partial answer.
At normal sixty-second completion, the actual completion answer precedes ordinary end-of-procedure teardown.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-05-A: A legal Wizard question concerns a real sealed archive door within120 feet. Pay17 and complete the uninterrupted60-second trance. An established, readable fact says an actual keeper holds the key and appointments are available. The answer can give that fact and a real next step within150 words, not a free entry, consent, map or guaranteed success. Self may be a legitimate question anchor under the same relation requirement.

DI7-05-B: Forced displacement at40 seconds ends the trance; no partial answer, parallel research/rest credit or refund occurs. In a separate uninterrupted inquiry, normal deadline completion delivers once before removing the effect. A future-expedition answer covers at most30 days from completion and only real conditional next steps/uncertainties, not guaranteed survival or rolled future dice.

cards.name: Faction Omniscience
cards.summary: KEEP known faction plus perceived local reference, paid hidden-membership resolution and a protected institution-wide live feed.
reviewFindings: Perceived, not visible, is the operative reference predicate; no new sense, sight or barrier bypass is supplied.
Preflight does not expose true/false/protected membership. Those facts and readable activity resolve after lawful commitment/payment without distinguishing diagnostics.
The readout covers the actual selected institution’s current business, including supported remote/unreported operations, rather than an arbitrary agent/project quota.
Reference loss after lawful establishment does not select another faction or end the selected institution by name; each actual native information defense retains only its scope.
Suppression/incapacity misses notices without backfill; return yields current readable information only, within the absolute deadline.
No actual save score, faction authority, reputation, alignment or membership is created or changed.
boundaryConclusions: An unseen but actually perceived in-range/line-of-effect creature can qualify.
A guessed unperceived creature fails public preflight.
False or relevant protected membership after a legal paid cast yields no distinguishing feed/diagnostic or refund.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-06-A: A genuine current member is nominated at a legal120-foot reference. Pay17; successful establishment discloses all readable current convoy, council and distant covert activity, not only the nearby member. Distance or a remote ordinary wall alone does not remove abstract institutional facts. An actually protected agent identity remains unavailable while independent objective/stage fields may be given. A false member gives no feed only after the paid hidden-reference evaluation, not a free membership probe.

DI7-06-B: In a feed established at0, the reference leaves membership at30. The selected faction stays fixed; genuinely private later conduct by that former member is excluded, while other real faction activities remain. Suppression10–20 misses those changes; return supplies the current20-second register, not a replay. At60 no fresh update is delivered; previous knowledge gives no membership, reputation or command authority.

cards.name: Alignment Purge
cards.summary: KEEP the temporary effective True Neutral overlay and the precisely limited AP-AS-01 precedence/baseline exception.
reviewFindings: Actual two-axis qualification is required; undefined hidden alignment is not converted into invented Neutral values.
The actual Wisdom save, concentration and60-second lifecycle control; Charmed-only immunity does not become immunity to every alignment alteration.
Purge covers a surviving Suggestion regardless of order; a new Suggestion target baseline excludes Purge and prior Suggestion but retains other actual changes.
The caster’s actual effective orientation remains its own snapshot; the named target-baseline exception is not exported elsewhere.
Underlying saved values, conduct, origins and acquisition history remain; suppression/end expose the then-current underlying effects, not stale snapshots.
All eight active AP-AS-01 readers and202 dependency bindings are preserved through the supplied guarded current counterparts. No unrelated spell/feat is promoted.
boundaryConclusions: A new Suggestion that shifts no target axis does not replace the old Suggestion merely by attempting.
Ending or suppressing Purge reveals a still-live underlying Suggestion and actual intervening changes; it does not restore an expired one.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-07-A: A paid legal cast atDC17 receives target WIS16 and two defined axes; absent actual immunity it establishes Neutral/Neutral for a concentration60 seconds. An applicable current-effective predicate reads those values. Acquired oath, class, views, conduct and ability opportunities remain unchanged. WIS17 negates with cost kept. Hidden undefined axes are not fabricated as Neutral and their absence is not disclosed by free preflight.

DI7-07-B: Target baseline is Lawful Good; another caster first establishes a Suggestion toward Chaotic Evil, recording fixed Neutral/Neutral. Purge from a separate caster then covers it. A new Good-oriented Suggestion target baseline excludes both older Suggestion and Purge; a Lawful Good caster finds no changed axes and creates no replacement. Later genuine underlying Neutral Evil change survives. End Purge while older Suggestion remains: its fixed Neutral/Neutral still applies. End that Suggestion: the lawful underlying Neutral Evil appears, not the old Lawful Good snapshot. Separate casters/actual concentration permissions are required for the fixture.

cards.name: Resonance Sight (Supreme)
cards.summary: KEEP the DI7-scoped3D metric, full established magical history and non-diagnostic precision/protection projection.
reviewFindings: The selected perceived center is fixed; caster-to-center range and20-foot membership use the explicit DI7 three-axis maximum metric, not an implicit Euclidean sphere.
Current center-to-portion line of effect clips real places. Fixed-center range/perception/line are revalidated at resolution without free retargeting.
All actually established past/present local magic remains in scope without arbitrary age/count cap, represented as real effect identities, intervals and transitions.
Unknown timing stays at real supported precision. A protection’s interval cannot manufacture a more precise historical timestamp or a new generic protection.
When exact native protection applicability is unresolved, disclose only independently safe supported facts, without a pending/protected diagnostic.
Partial readable continuity uses positive genuine facts/transitions without invented protection-boundary transitions, hidden counts, gap markers or certified completeness.
A current-only ward does not erase independently readable historical events. History readout is not direct original observation, a Fate receipt, reconstruction or acquisition.
boundaryConclusions: Offsets(20,20,20),(20,0,5) and(0,0,20) are within the defined20-foot maximum metric; an axis beyond20 is outside.
Unresolved occurrence100–200 versus actual trace defense150–175 does not justify an invented date or a public redaction diagnostic.
One continuous effect with a protected middle retains one internal identity; only independently readable positive assertions are projected.

sourceBasis.scope: Resolve a cast at the table; components; copied-source and AP-AS-01 exceptions

workedExamples.text: DI7-08-A: Pay17 to read a legal fixed20-foot sphere containing an active ward and an established three-day-old magical blast. Both readable occurrences appear with actual local footprints and chronology; the ended blast is not omitted. Unknown caster identity/current location remains unknown. Reading that history is not an observed-original event for Fate Echo.

DI7-08-B: An enchantment actually persisted for a century; represent one interval and its established transitions, not billions of generated casts. An unestablished/protected period supplies neither fabricated history nor proof of no magic. An existence-protected event adds no placeholder/count. Equivalent unchanged queries repeat the same readable record; a real newly established fact may change a later paid answer.
